utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure — I’ll grab my toolbox and meet you by the side gate for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good — I’ll keep repeating that we’re set for Saturday morning and let folks know to meet by the side gate.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it — Saturday morning at the side gate works for me.

utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Faye — the repair drive has moved to Sunday at the community center, and I’m keeping the list updated so we can stay organized.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Rosa — Sunday at the community center works, and I’ll coordinate around school pickup. Please keep me posted if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely, Faye — I’ll let you know right away if anything changes, and I’ll keep the volunteer list tidy for Sunday.

utterances.speaker: Oren

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Oren — I’ll let you know as soon as the time’s confirmed. Boxes, tape, and markers sound perfect.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Great, thanks — I’ll wait for the confirmed time, and I’ll keep an eye out for that folding table too.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: It’s going pretty well so far, and a few folks have already dropped things off. We could still use a hand if you want to jump in.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh—good to hear. I can help if you still need someone, but I may have missed the latest timing, so just tell me what to do.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Noah — could you help by spreading the word that Saturday morning is still the plan, and I’ll send you any updates if anything changes?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: We still need a few donated tools and someone to help sort the drop-off table. If you can swing by for about an hour, that’d be a huge help.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I can swing by for an hour and help sort the drop-off table — and I’ll keep asking around about the repair drive too.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That’d be a huge help, Ira — thank you. If you can keep asking around, I’ll have the drop-off table ready for you when you get here.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll keep spreading the word and make sure folks know the repair drive is underway. If you want, I can point Leo toward the first repairs to watch for too.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Quinn — please point me to the first repairs to watch for.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Of course — I’ll point you to the first few repairs and keep the updates coming so you don’t miss anything.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Uli, sorry I’m late — what’s the latest on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I’m checking the latest details now and keeping it low-key today. I’ll let you know what’s still needed once I’ve got it sorted.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Uli — I’ll wait for your update and help spread the word once you’ve got the list.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, Nell, it’s really coming together nicely — folks are already dropping off tools and paint. I’ll keep spreading the word so a few more neighbors can swing by.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Tess — I’ve only heard bits and pieces, so I’m glad it’s coming together. If you hear which repairs are first up, just point me there and I’ll help where I can.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, absolutely — I’ll ask around and let you know as soon as I hear which repairs they’re starting with. It’s shaping up to be a really helpful little neighborhood effort.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it—besides the front gate and hall light, what else still needs fixing?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: We still need a few tools and extra hands for the small patch jobs and loose railings. If you can grab a screwdriver set or help organize folks, that’d be a big help.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I can do that. What time and place should I tell people to show up?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Good, Saturday morning still works for me. I’ll check the schedule and be there on time unless I hear otherwise.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Eli — please let me know the exact time once you confirm the schedule, and I’ll wait before doing anything.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Will do — I’ll check the schedule and let you know the exact time as soon as I confirm it.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help sort the drop-off table for about an hour, and I’ll keep an eye out for donated tools too.

utterances.speaker: Cleo

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sure — I’ll be there for the drop-off table and any donated tools I can sort.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’m still watching the repair drive by the side gate, and I’ll let you know right away if it moves.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, just checking — so it’s really happening, not just a maybe?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Yes — it’s really happening; I’m still watching the repair drive by the side gate and I’ll tell you right away if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can come by around 10 and help sort the drop-off table. I’ll also keep an eye out for any donated tools and check on the front gate and hall light.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds great — I’ll keep telling folks we’re on for Saturday morning and let everyone know about your 10 o’clock help.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Vik — I appreciate it. I’ll be there at 10 and check the gate and hall light too.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure — I’ll check the latest repair drive doc and the top section for the details.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Bo — I’ll check it now and catch up on the details.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it — I’m on it and will skim the top section now.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, the repair drive is actually happening, right?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, I think so — I may have missed an update, though. If you want, I can check the latest details and get back to you.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, please do — I just want to make sure it’s actually on before I count on it.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Yes, please check with the organizer — I’d feel much better once we know the location, time, and what they’re accepting.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’ll check with the organizer and let you know as soon as I have the location, time, and what they’re accepting.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Opal — I appreciate it. Once you have those details, I can help make sure we’re set.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yeah, I think they’ve got enough volunteers now — I’m still waiting on the final schedule details. I’ll let you know if I hear anything new while I’m out.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good — just let me know when the schedule’s set, and I’ll be ready to help with whatever’s needed.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Will do — I’ll keep an ear out while I’m running errands and pass along any schedule update I hear.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Rosa — I’m still keeping track of the supplies, so if you hear of any extra boxes, tape, markers, or folding tables, send them my way.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Cleo — I’ll keep an eye out and send any extra supplies your way right away.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Rosa — I really appreciate it. I’ll keep updating the supply list so we can spot any gaps fast.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks — I’ll wait for the exact repair-drive details before I do anything.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Of course — I’ll send the exact repair-drive details as soon as I have them, and then you can jump in whenever you’re ready.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks — I’ll wait for the exact details and hold off until you send them.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Gus — I’ve only heard bits and pieces, so if you can tell me the first repairs to note, I’ll help however I can.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Nell — first I’m marking the loose porch rail and the leaky faucet, then we’ll see what else needs attention. If you can jot those down, that’d be a big help.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Absolutely, Gus — I’ll note the loose porch rail and the leaky faucet first, and I’ll keep an ear out for anything else people mention.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Eli — I’m still spreading the word and keeping Saturday morning as the plan. If you want to help, I can point you to a few neighbors who’d be glad to pitch in.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Jules. Keep me posted, and I’ll be there Saturday morning unless I hear otherwise.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Will do — I’ll let you know if anything changes, and thanks for being there Saturday morning.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yes — it’s already picking up nicely, and I can spread the word to anyone nearby. If you want, I’ll pass along the repair drive details too.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Tess — please share the latest Repair Drive doc and read the top section for the details.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Sure thing — I’ll share the Repair Drive details and read the top section for you. It’s coming together nicely, with folks already dropping off useful supplies.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks — I’m still waiting on the confirmed time, and I’ll let you know as soon as I have it so we can work around school pickup.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Faye — I’ll keep checking, and I’ll send the exact time as soon as I have it. I can also bring the boxes, tape, and markers.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Oren — that would be a big help. Just send the time when you have it, and I’ll coordinate around pickup.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: We’re still looking for a few donated tools, and I could use someone to sort the drop-off table for about an hour. If you can swing by, I’d really appreciate it.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I can do the drop-off table for an hour. Do you still need me to check the location and accepted items too?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Yes, please—if you could check the location and accepted items too, that’d be a huge help. I really appreciate it.
